description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'ReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec' for serializing and deserializing reference types using surrogates in the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for reading/writing values and converting between types and surrogates.

classes.name: ReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec
classes.description: An abstract class for serializing reference types via surrogate serialization, supporting customizable conversion between the actual type and its surrogate.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value from the reader, using reference handling if applicable, or via surrogate deserialization if the type matches.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a value to the writer, handling references and surrogate serialization accordingly.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate value back to the original field type.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a value of the field type into its surrogate representation.
